actions.title: GlobalForge: Towards Robust AI-Generated Image Detection
actions.source_target_basis: Existing decision-sheet arXiv identity; full-paper target required by external-evidence plan
actions.identity_verification: PDF title, author sequence and arXiv identifier match the local public record
actions.contribution_framing: Contribution 1 explicitly claims diagnosis of detector fragility.
actions.systematic_analysis_scope: Training/test crop versus resize; degradation effects across three detectors.
actions.analysis_methodology: Controlled preprocessing cross-experiment and cross-detector attention diagnosis.
actions.independent_analysis_findings: Existing detectors depend on fragile local cues disrupted by degradation.
actions.routine_evaluation_signals: Component ablations and hyperparameter sweeps exist; those alone are excluded.
actions.r3_reason: The separately claimed and tested diagnosis supports a primary analysis role.

actions.title: Reduce the Artifact Bias for More Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
actions.source_target_basis: Existing decision-sheet arXiv identity; full-paper target required by external-evidence plan
actions.identity_verification: PDF title, author sequence and arXiv identifier match the local public record
actions.contribution_framing: Contribution 1 claims artifact-bias identification and generalization analysis.
actions.systematic_analysis_scope: VAE/SRGAN artifact profiles, generator families, single/mixed-source training, gradient alignment.
actions.analysis_methodology: Matched training comparisons, gradient diagnostics and conditional theoretical arguments.
actions.independent_analysis_findings: Aligned sources generalize differently; mixing can produce conflicting gradients.
actions.routine_evaluation_signals: Fusion ablations, parameter sweeps and robustness tables are supporting evaluation.
actions.r3_reason: Artifact-bias characterization is separately claimed and empirically tested beyond ACEF performance.
